findings.detail: Description of "update_recipe_build" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_recipe_build_activity · Private data: get_recipe_build, review_recipe_build, run_recipe_acceptance, start_recipe_build, update_recipe_build · Public sink: commit_recipe_build · Destructive: check_recipe_build, discover_stewai, get_results, get_run, review_recipe_build, run_recipe, run_recipe_acceptance.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_recipe_build_activity · Private data: get_recipe_build, review_recipe_build, run_recipe_acceptance, start_recipe_build, update_recipe_build · Public sink: commit_recipe_build · Destructive: check_recipe_build, discover_stewai, get_results, get_run, review_recipe_build, run_recipe, run_recipe_acceptance

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
